svg.text: Make 2; turn one over for the right. Plate 67 x 40 mm.

svg.text: Four 7 mm holes for two M6 U-bolts, 29 mm apart across and 26 mm

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: apart up and down; one slot and one 9 mm hole for the arm.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: The plate runs 43 mm in from the leg's centre: at full lock

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: its front inboard corner meets the lock stop (FTK-DWG-124).

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Fit: the plate sits behind the inboard fork leg, which trails the

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: steering axis by 35 mm; the U-bolts go round the leg from the

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: front and pull the plate against it; the long end points in.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Check: the U-bolts' legs pass through without forcing.
